studies.preparation: 10,061 participants with prior myocardial infarction and hsCRP at least 2 mg/L received placebo or canakinumab 50/150/300 mg subcutaneously every three months. The 300-mg group had an initial loading schedule. Cardiovascular events were adjudicated; median follow-up was 3.7 years.
